info.name: Nasdaq Data Link Time-Series REST API

params.name: databaseCode
params.description: Database code (e.g., FRED, WIKI, CHRIS, BCOM)

params.name: datasetCode
params.description: Dataset code within the database (e.g., GDP, AAPL)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of rows to return (0 returns all)

params.name: column_index
params.description: Request a specific column (1-based index)

params.name: start_date
params.description: Retrieve data rows on and after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: end_date
params.description: Retrieve data rows up to and including this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: order
params.description: Return data in ascending or descending date order

params.name: collapse
params.description: Frequency to collapse data to

params.name: transform
params.description: Mathematical transformation to apply to values

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your Nasdaq Data Link API key

items.docs: Returns time-series data from a Nasdaq Data Link dataset. Supports date range filtering, column selection, frequency transformation, and return type selection (JSON, XML, CSV).

params.name: datatablesCode
params.description: Database code and datatable code joined by slash (e.g. ZACKS/FC)

params.name: qopts.columns
params.description: Comma-separated column names to return

params.name: qopts.per_page
params.description: Number of rows per page (max 10000)

params.name: qopts.cursor_id
params.description: Cursor ID for pagination from previous response

params.name: qopts.export
params.description: Set to true to get a download link for full dataset

items.docs: Returns rows from a Nasdaq Data Link datatable (tabular dataset). Supports row-level filtering, column selection, and pagination using cursor-based pagination. Maximum 10,000 rows per call.
